name: com.stitchpunk.dotsanimationtoolkit
description: DOTS-native animation toolkit for Unity Entities: 2.5D cutout transform tracks, flipbook sprite animation, and bone/vertex animation textures (VAT), with blob-baked clip registries, Burst-compiled sampling, and a full editor clip pipeline. Playback, layer compositing and crossfades, animation events, bounds and LOD, VAT texture baking with multi-source tracks, standalone HLSL shader components, and asset inspectors are all in place. The Clip Editor authors transform, flipbook and bone tracks against a live preview, places socket attachment points with preview attachments, and hands structural editing to Unity's prefab mode with binding reconciliation on return. Pre-release: 0.9.0's editor surface — socket placement, prefab-authoring round trip and Rig Edit mode — is new and has had automated but not extensive hands-on use. Remaining before 1.0: a clean-project import check and a player build.

samples.description: Generates a complete working actor - rig, clip set, an animated clip, and a prefab wired to bake - through the same public API you would use yourself.

Generates an actor using two techniques at once - cutout limbs on transform tracks and a flipbook face on sprite tracks - from one clip on one timeline, with a socket and an event marker. Includes a generated Texture2DArray, so it ships no binary fixtures.
